SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS account_count
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE a.date >= '940617' AND a.date <= '960902'
GROUP BY d.A3;

assumptions.assumption: Account dates are stored as YYMMDD text, so comparing against the matching six-character date strings gives the requested inclusive range.
